summary: Recovery: CORS structure fix - callback null/false was breaking Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. Reverted to working structure with credentials: true inside cors() options.

learnings.evidence: Error log: 'No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is present' - caused by incorrect callback return value
learnings.title: CORS callback pattern
learnings.body: callback(null, false) nao envia Access-Control-Allow-Origin header. Must use callback(new Error('message')) for blocked origins, or callback(null, true, { 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': origin }) for allowed origins.

verification: CORS structure: credentials: true inside cors() options (not outside)
Origin callback: returns Error for blocked origins, not callback(null, false)
Additional CORS headers: methods, allowedHeaders, optionsSuccessStatus added
